outcome: use of postnatal systemic corticosteroids for lung disease
treatment with supplemental oxygen at 28 days' postnatal age
treatment with supplemental oxygen at 36 weeks' postmenstrual age
cohort: 97,377 infants born in Sweden between 2009 and 2018 without malformations who were admitted for neonatal care
finding: While the first surfactant administration more than 2 hours after birth was associated with higher odds of pneumothorax, intraventricular hemorrhage, postnatal corticosteroid use, and longer duration of assisted ventilation, it was also associated with higher survival.
gest_age: Full term, 32 to 36 weeks, 28 to 31 weeks, and less than 28 weeks
followup_time: 28 days postnatal age, 36 weeks postmenstrual age
